description: Blog public HTML: respect short origin TTLs
expression: (http.host eq "www.theslowmo.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/about/" "/archive/" "/moments/" "/tags/" "/links/" "/search/"} or ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/posts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tags/")) and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/"))))
